canons.summary: Collin’s commitment is not contingent on the Pascal app shipping
ME-setup completion is priority #1 before venture/Pascal/Sovereign-Consultancy work.
TEAM-CYCLE SUB-TASK-1 is focused on the AI Coaching CRM Landscape 2026.
There is a CORE GAP: no purpose-built AI coaching CRM for independent coaches with 30-50 clients.
Top coaching tools currently include practice management software (CoachAccountable, Paperbell, Quenza) and enterprise-only AI platforms (BetterUp, Torch).
Gong and Chorus provide conversation intelligence for sales, but not for coaching.
Pascal-arm remains OFF to maintain customer focus.
Pascal coaching 2026 state was banked this cycle.
Moment-of-need feedback makes coaching stick, and between-session support drives behavior change from episodic to habitual.
